title: Tutoring Intake Form
subtitle: Capture subject area, learning goal, schedule, and baseline evidence; confirm communication route and progress review.
description: Tutoring records subject area, learning goal, schedule, baseline evidence, communication route, and progress review. Tutoring evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this tutoring structured intake when staff must document subject area and learning goal. Reconcile schedule, baseline evidence, communication route, and progress review before the tutoring handoff. Use the learning-goal statement, baseline assignment, assessment sample, tutor calendar, session notes, family updates, progress measure, and review summary. For tutoring live use, check roster. Reconcile the tutoring schedule and actual handoff times. Preserve the tutoring roster and schedule. Record the tutoring handoff time and instructions. Close the tutoring exception queue. Verify tutoring day-of-service timing. Resolve tutoring real-time changes and operating handoff for tutoring. Ask the assigned tutoring reviewer to confirm subject area against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Tutoring starting details
sections.guidance: Define subject area, learning goal, baseline work sample, session cadence, tutor assignment, communication route, progress measure, and review date.

sections.title: Tutoring reported needs review
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Tutoring intake readiness
items: Subject area is identified for this record
Learning goal matches the current request or source
Schedule is ready for point-of-use staff
Baseline evidence limits or questions are resolved
Communication route is communicated to the responsible person
Progress review is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Tutoring decision and receiving route
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Tutoring intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
